events.statement: order-service deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) was deployed at 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z and its rollout completed at 12:10:08Z; its change summary is 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders' with changes 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and 'remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'.

order-service began throwing NullPointerException in MarginCheckValidator.validate at 12:12:31Z (first occurrence), with dominant patterns 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO' and 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account <n>'.
order-service error_rate jumped from ~0.2% (buckets 11:30–12:05) to 18.49% in the 12:12 bucket and stayed elevated (~17.9–18.97%) through 13:57, with no recovery.
The errors continue at high volume through the latest data: 12:59–13:59 window logged 238 ERROR entries, same MarginCheckValidator NPE patterns first_seen 12:59:08.

Deployment dep-5101 was NOT rolled back: status 'live', rolled_back_at null. The only other recent deployment was portfolio-service dep-5088 at 09:36 (dependency bumps, grpc 1.62->1.63), which predates onset by ~2.5h and was followed by no impact.

order-service resource/load metrics are flat across the incident: cpu_pct ~40%, memory_pct ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14 connections, request_rate ~232 req/s, latency_p99 ~150ms, restarts 0 — no saturation, exhaustion or restart.

Downstream dependencies are healthy: pricing-engine error_rate ~0.22%, exchange-gateway error_rate ~0.21% with zero ERROR logs, portfolio-service error_rate ~0.21% with zero ERROR logs, ledger-db slow_queries_per_min ~1.0 and cpu_pct ~30% — all unchanged across the incident window.
api-gateway error_rate rose from ~0.2% to ~3.4% starting in the 12:10 bucket, consistent with propagated order-service failures (its own metrics and downstreams otherwise normal).

The only config/feature-flag change in the window was notification-service cfg-2101 (email.batch_size 200->250) at 11:21Z, unrelated to order-service. order-service log shows 'config reloaded (no changes)' at 12:07:51Z.

Historical incidents include similar past cases: HIST-115 order-service connection pool misconfiguration (config_change) and HIST-109 token validation regression after library upgrade (bad_deployment, resolved by rollback).

Ambiguous/unrelated noise present: a single WARN 'GC pause <n>ms exceeded <n>ms target' at 12:37:35Z on order-service, and portfolio-service WARNs 'slow request 865ms on /internal/metrics' (11:41) and 'deprecated TLS cipher offered by client' (13:40) — none correlate with onset.
